summary: [¶] Corrigendum to order dated 31.3.2017 in Petition No. 289/GT/2014 [¶] The petitioner, NTPC had filed the said petition for approval of tariff of Feroze Gandhi Unchahar Thermal Power Station, Stage- II (420 MW) (“the generating station) for the period from 1.4.2014 to 31.3.2019 and the Commission by order dated 31.3.2017 had determined the annual fixed charges for the period 2014-19 as under: [para 2] 2. It is noticed that in the said order dated 31.3.2017, the expenditure on account of [¶] amended, the error is rectified and the order dated 31.3.2017 is modified by considering the secondary fuel oil for computation of Interest on working capital as stated under: [para 5] 5. Based on the above, the receivable component of the working capital in the table under para-84 of order dated 31.3.2017 stands modified as under: [para 6] 6. Accordingly, the Interest on working capital in table under para-88 of the order dated [¶] order dated 31.3.2017 is revised as under: [para 8] 8. All other terms of the order dated 31.3.2017 shall remain unchanged.
title: Corrigendum to order dated 31.3.2017 in Petition No. 289/GT/2014. NTPC
